text: APPROVE. Extracting the parent lookup into `TryGetParent` removes the `||` sequence from the loop, which should take the complexity from 16 to 15. The behaviour is identical, since `dir` is copied in by value, is left unchanged when the helper returns false, and the loop breaks either way. I found nothing in the diff that would break the build under warnings-as-errors, though I only saw the diff, not the full file.
